description.value: Purcell House Hostel, also known as HI Cranbrook, is a Hostelling International-affiliated property located on the College of the Rockies campus in Cranbrook, BC. Operating seasonally (summer only per OSM), it occupies what appears to be a student residence building and serves as the primary budget accommodation option in this East Kootenay gateway city. Its campus setting on College Way places it away from the town centre but within reach of the Cranbrook trail network.
